review.title: TCP groundwater and Wheat DT: bounded genus-reference correspondences
review.independence_basis: The parent read both canonical records, retained primary evidence, current historical callers and complete native routes. Separate peers independently read each source preparation and each actual M5 candidate with its captured inputs before application. The parent read every actual native gate log and sidecar. These are bounded taxonomy assessments, not new full scientific reviews.
review.summary: The two actual M5 applications add sixteen generic genus-reference blocks, three complete ambiguity sets and nineteen changed statuses across twenty taxonomy occurrences. TCP retains four generic genus descriptors; Wheat retains sixteen distinct source stocks, including repeated genus identifiers and unchanged W16 Ensifer ambiguity. Four native inline events and two native sidecars document the exact transitions. All source quotations, biological claims, stock notes and old history remain unchanged. Sixteen actual native commands passed.
review.scope_description: The nineteen selected descriptors' native GTDB blocks, statuses and complete alternatives, with exact source/application/history/check provenance. Existing experimental and causal claims are preserved without new approval.
review.selection: Two independent whole-record units, CommunityMech:000437 and CommunityMech:000429, following the completed Diclofenac379 M5 canary. PPCP420 remains separate and has not used the new mixed fungal-domain workflow.
limitations: Partial technical diagnostic with scientific_review:false. Six bounded assessments and sixteen native commands do not complete full scientific review, article-reference validation, generated products, aggregate QC or the all-record campaign.

TCP source coverage is the retained primary abstract for PMID41736479. It names four genera and a proposed coupled metabolic module; no full paper, supplementary material, stock genome or direct donor-to-recipient experiment was reviewed. Its19.06 micromol/L/day and3.5-day endpoints remain culture-level and are not assigned to every amendment or member.

TCP reference populations are Desulfovibrio551/592, Nitratidesulfovibrio17/30 and Parabacteroides15116/15122, plus all three Fusibacter alternatives. The17/30 majority is weak, and rounded1.0 for15116/15122 is not unanimity. No isolated stock or member-specific TCP degradation identity is established.

Wheat source reading covers the retained PMID42453107 main-text Methods, all W1-W16 Table1 rows and selected Results/Discussion. The16S accessions are markers, not study genome assemblies. All sixteen stocks remain distinct; W3/W7 retain separate complete eleven-option Arthrobacter sets, W8/W10 remain separate Pseudomonas stocks, and W16 Ensifer alternatives are unchanged.

Wheat reference populations do not prove individual stock identities. Bacillus4981/8737 across44 reference taxa, Pseudomonas17956/25706 and other nonunanimous populations remain explicit. Equal-volume OD inputs and99percent16S classification do not establish strain-specific revival or endpoint dominance.

Preserve wheat origin versus barley experimental host,43.3percent leaf DAF endpoint without superiority over barley or WCS417, PEG-screen versus plant-drought distinctions and prechallenge transcript measurements without causal hormone/pathway assignment. Existing source gaps and current biological predicates are unchanged.

Crosswalk bytes are pinned; release is unestablished and file mtime is not a release. Local NCBI authority observations use file-stat provenance, not complete database hashing or ontology-release certification. These generic correspondences are not sample abundances, viability measurements or stock probabilities.

Actual M5 staging/application and all sixteen commands ran at cfa5f0934c5e52a3945fc5bd8162daaa03ee9ba5 with Python3.13.2. The source binders were run locally at that revision with Python3.13.12; the original route preparation was at3973ff3358bbc3edbbd97734602ad5fae7272e67. Local mirrored files do not relabel those execution revisions.

The sixteen commands include two native history scaffolds and fourteen scoped validators. Strict historical admission and checkpoint preservation remain separate. Keep batch124's existing210 admission and other records, and batch122's existing species/genus/note transitions and current biological constraints; do not rewrite literal ledgers or treat this diagnostic as resolving old findings.

records.label: Fifteen selected genus descriptors across sixteen distinct Wheat DT stocks

evidence.locator: Retained main text, Methods/Table1 W1-W16, selected Results/Discussion; exact source anchors retained in bound source metadata.
evidence.summary: Table1 identifies sixteen separate wheat-origin stocks with marker accessions. Shared Arthrobacter/Pseudomonas labels do not collapse stock identity, and the subsequent host experiments concern barley. Stock-specific viability and causal pathway effects are not established by generic reference mappings.

evidence.locator: Selected indices0-14: thirteen exact genus routes, two complete eleven-option Arthrobacter lists and captured NCBI identities; W16 excluded from change.
evidence.summary: The native computation adds thirteen reference-genus blocks and complete lists for W3 and W7 without selecting an Arthrobacter alternative. Nonunanimous Bacillus/Pseudomonas and other populations are not probabilities that a source stock belongs to the leading generic label.

evidence.summary: Application persistedd67a7ccb after independent source and actual-candidate reads. Thirteen blocks, two complete lists, fifteen changed statuses and two native events changed; native processing of sixteen taxa does not imply sixteen changed entries.

assessments.topic: Sixteen source stocks and marker identities remain separate
assessments.summary: The selected primary rows support keeping sixteen distinct stock/marker descriptors, repeated genus labels and the unmodified W16 ambiguity. No genus-reference correspondence establishes an individual isolate genome, survival or endpoint abundance.

assessments.topic: Thirteen reference-genus blocks and two complete ambiguity lists
assessments.summary: All thirteen blocks retain exact native populations and both Arthrobacter stocks retain all eleven ordered alternatives. The native taxonomy representation is bounded to generic references and leaves stock identities and biological assertions unchanged.
